name: Sun Arc
description: The sun's path for one day: an arc from sunrise to sunset with the sun at a time you can scrub.

props.name: time
props.description: The time the sun shows, "HH:MM". Controlled; pair with onTimeChange.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Starting time when uncontrolled. Defaults to solar noon, halfway between sunrise and sunset.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called as the sun is dragged, the sky is clicked, or the arrow keys move it a minute at a time (Page Up and Page Down a tenth of the range, Home and End to the ends). The range runs from a little before sunrise to a little after sunset.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading, also the slider's accessible name. Assistive technology hears the time and how long until sunrise or sunset.

props.name: twilight
props.description: Minutes of twilight shaded at each end of the day, where the arc dips below the horizon.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the sky in pixels. The arc fills the width of its container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. Other div props are passed through.
